name: skewness
expr: s1 = skewness(x); s0 = skewness(x, 0); sM = skewness(M);
comment: Sig s=skewness(X[,flag[,dim]]): sample skewness. Default flag=1 (biased, /N): skewness([2 4 4 4 5 5 7 9])=0.65625. flag=0 (bias-corrected): 0.818488. Matrix is per-column: skewness(magic(4)) = [0.686021 -0.263374 0.263374 -0.686021] (antisymmetric over the magic columns).
